en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate resort hotel set amid lush gardens with palm trees and winding paths. The multi‑story building features towers with domed roofs, many balconies, and an arched bridge-like structure connecting wings over a garden walkway. A person can be seen seated on a bench in the landscaped grounds. In the sky area on the right, the red number "6725." is printed.
